en: Welcome to the Algebraic Progression Textbook! This tab serves as an in-game guide that updates as you progress throughout the game.
zh: 欢迎来到 Algebraic Progression 教科书！这个标签页是游戏内指南，会随着你在游戏中的进度而更新。

en: Algebraic Progression is an incremental game where the goal is to get all of the Achievements and win the game. The game's mechanics
zh: Algebraic Progression 是一款增量游戏，目标是获得所有成就并赢得游戏。游戏的机制

en: are inspired by various aspects of algebra in mathematics, however most mechanics do not faithfully represent how they actually work.
zh: 受到数学中代数诸多方面的启发，然而大多数机制并不忠实地反映它们的实际运作方式。

en: The game also features common incremental game mechanics, such as Upgrades, Challenges, Buildings, Automation, and Milestones.
zh: 游戏还包含常见的增量游戏机制，例如升级、挑战、建筑、自动化和里程碑。

en: Each section afterward covers every important mechanic in the game that may require explaining. There are a few things that you should
zh: 之后的每一节都涵盖了游戏中可能需要解释的每个重要机制。有几件事你应该

en: know before your start your journey:
zh: 在开始旅程之前知道：

en: While there are some idle sections, this game is active and grindy.
zh: 虽然有一些挂机部分，但这款游戏需要主动操作且相当肝。

en: This game has offline progress! This means that resources keep producing while you're away. Use this to your advantage.
zh: 这款游戏有离线进度！这意味着当你离开时资源仍会持续产出。好好利用这一点。

en: If you ever feel stuck, keep waiting and grinding, or ask for help on the Discord server. (linked in the Options tab)
zh: 如果你曾感到卡关，就继续等待和刷，或者在 Discord 服务器上寻求帮助。（链接在选项标签页中）

en: Before you complain about something not having very many uses or ask for a QoL mechanic, it might already be in the game,
zh: 在你抱怨某个东西用途不多或请求某个 QoL 机制之前，它可能已经在游戏中，

en: but is unlocked later.
zh: 只是稍后才会解锁。

en: There may still be things that need to be polished. Don't be scared if you encounter issues!
zh: 可能仍有一些需要打磨的地方。如果遇到问题不要害怕！

en: Anyway, good luck and enjoy the ride!
zh: 总之，祝你好运，享受这段旅程！
